title: Update the Go bump template and stop Renovate Go version MRs
description:
## Why

`.gitlab/issue_templates/bump-golang.md` is stale. It asks for `GO_FIPS_VERSION_SUFFIX` and `*.rebuild` files, neither of which exists any more, and it skips the base-images step. Since !7079, `scripts/check-go-version-consistency` checks the main Go version locations in CI, but nothing points people at it, so a missed location only shows up as a QA job failure.
